item.title: Texas Issues Annual Reminder Not To Shoot Santa
item.description: AUSTIN, TX — The State of Texas has issued its annual reminder for residents to please refrain from shooting Santa Claus.

item.title: Uh-Oh: Car You Honked And Swore At For Driving Too Slow Just Turned Into Your Church Parking Lot
item.description: SANTA FE, NM — After honking and swearing at a slow-moving car this morning, Marcus Nabors watched in horror as the car slowly turned its way into the parking lot of Nabors' church.
